mechanism: Part I only builds EasyAndFastGUI Trade/Positions tabs, symbol table, Stochastic level inputs, and chart chrome; no live sensing logic is executed here.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Forex symbols (default EURUSD D1 subchart); TF combo M1–MN
why_new_for_mis: No market sensing idea after full read of part I—GUI panel assembly only; sensing is in part II.
quote: In this article, we consider developing the panel, while the next one describes filling it with functions.

mechanism: For each filtered forex symbol, iStochastic(...,5,3,3) on the selected TF; color cells blue if value < Down level, red if > Up level (defaults 20/80). Request rebuilds symbol list; timer refreshes values every 5s. Concurrent multi-symbol overbought/oversold board.
data_needed: Market Watch forex symbols; Stochastic handles per symbol; Up/Down level inputs; chosen ENUM_TIMEFRAMES.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Forex symbols filtered by name (USD/EUR examples); TF combo M1–MN; Stochastic default 5,3,3
why_new_for_mis: Cross-sectional oscillator regime board: same Stochastic thresholds scored simultaneously across many FX pairs for MIS breadth/regime heatmaps.
quote: Values below Stochastic indicator will be highlighted in blue as buy signals, while values above the indicator maximum are highlighted in red as sell ones.

mechanism: DepositLoad(percent_mode,price,symbol,volume) = margin/equity×100 (or raw margin). Per-symbol margin from volume×contract_size/leverage (×price if account≠base currency); account-wide uses ACCOUNT_MARGIN. Status bar and Positions table refresh every 0.5–1s.
data_needed: Open positions (symbol, volume, avg price); ACCOUNT_EQUITY/MARGIN/LEVERAGE; SYMBOL_TRADE_CONTRACT_SIZE and base currency.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any open forex positions on the account; live ticks
why_new_for_mis: Live per-symbol vs total deposit-load sensor—MIS can treat exposure concentration as a risk-regime feature alongside price regimes.
quote: the second one displays the deposit load for the entire account… Please note that a deposit load is displayed per each symbol separated by "/" in money and percentage terms.

mechanism: Parse OBJ_ARROW_BUY/SELL marks from Signal 'Show Trades on Chart'; infer DEAL_ENTRY_IN/OUT/INOUT by netting volume per symbol; rebuild balance and equity timeseries on PERIOD_M5 bars (mark-to-market open lots with tick_value). Panel filters by symbol, long/short, date range.
data_needed: Chart arrow objects from a selected Signal; M5 rates per traded symbol; date pickers.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any Signal provider symbols present on charts; analysis TF fixed PERIOD_M5
why_new_for_mis: Reconstructs provider P&L paths per instrument—MIS can sense signal-strategy regime, concurrent load, and when max drawdown/profit clusters by symbol.
quote: Seeing how evenly the signal works on different symbols; Knowing how the load on the deposit is distributed and how many positions can be opened simultaneously; At what moments and on what symbols the largest drawdowns occur.

mechanism: From closed positions sorted by close time: accumulate separate profit-only and loss-only histograms (hold prior value on opposite outcomes); PF_t = cum_profit/|cum_loss|. Sideways PF>1 = healthy; PF→1 = dead; PF<1 = losing regime. Also builds 1-lot and indicative (loss/max-win-lot normalized) PL curves.
data_needed: DealDetales history (symbol, open/close DT, volume, PL); optional balance.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Demo/real FORTS history (Si-12.17, RTS-12.17/3.18 etc.); deal-level, not bar TF
why_new_for_mis: Turns strategy equity into a continuous PF-regime sensor—MIS can flag when a book’s edge is expanding, flat, or collapsing without waiting for terminal drawdown alone.
quote: the main point in trading is not how the PL graph changes, but how the histogram of profitable and losing deals behaves, and consequently, what the dynamics of the profit factor change is.

mechanism: Aggregate closed-position PL by ENUM_DAY_OF_WEEK of open or close (absolute sum or simple average) plus counts of winning vs losing deals per weekday—calendar performance profile of a strategy.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same FORTS/demo deal history as above; weekday aggregation
why_new_for_mis: Calendar microstructure of strategy P&L—MIS can sense day-of-week edge regimes for books or for market-seasonality features when applied to returns.
quote: A combined analysis of this histogram with the PL graph by day gives a more accurate trading picture in the context of a week.

mechanism: CTimeserie loads N bars of applied price, converts to point changes Δp/Point; CPairPlot builds N×N panel: diagonal = distribution histograms of Δp; off-diagonal = scatter(Δp_i,Δp_j) with trend line. Refresh on new bar. Visual cross-sectional dependence sensor.
data_needed: Array of symbols; bars depth (default 1000); cells for histogram bins; ENUM_APPLIED_PRICE; timeframe.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Example EURUSD, GBPUSD, EURGBP; PERIOD_CURRENT; 1000 bars; 50 histogram cells
why_new_for_mis: Graphical pairwise correlation of returns across an arbitrary FX basket—MIS can use scatter/trend slopes as a live co-movement regime sensor for basket/arbitrage gates.
quote: The main purpose of the tool lies in the analysis of trading instruments and in the development of various arbitrage strategies… the search for correlated instruments and their dependencies.

mechanism: Two CRsiPlus instances share ATR: rsi_in uses BREAK_IN_REVERSE (trend entries after rollback through multi-level RSI channel); rsi_out uses BREAK_OUT_REVERSE (flat/impulse exits). Arrows vs dots separate regimes; separate SignalLevelIn/Out. Continuous buy/sell signal counters buffer series length.
data_needed: Close series; RSI period; dual signal levels; ATR period; spread for level buffers.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: AUDUSD H1 illustrated; RSI period 8; ATR 100–200; chart window version
why_new_for_mis: Single oscillator emits simultaneous trend-regime and flat-regime signal streams with counters—MIS can fuse dual-regime labels without running two separate indicators.
quote: Trend-based signals will be displayed as arrows, and as dots for the flat-based signals… it is possible to develop a system with differently directed positions.

mechanism: DirectionControl deletes a same-direction RSI signal if |price_signal − prior_signal_level| < ATR[i], or if price violates buy-low/sell-high ordering for the break mode. Ties signal acceptance to current volatility envelope.
data_needed: ATR buffer; RSI signal price levels; buy/sell counters.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same as RSI_PLUS chart versions; ATR period input
why_new_for_mis: Volatility-gated signal spacing—MIS can treat ATR-relative impulse size as a filter so regime events are not over-sampled in quiet markets.
quote: If there is a signal, but the size of the impulse is smaller than the current volatility… the signal is erased.

mechanism: CHedgePositionInfo collects tickets by symbol(+magic); HedgeType from buy vs sell volumes (BUY/SELL/NETTING_BUY/NETTING_SELL/LOCKED); Volume returns net and legs; Margin splits uncovered vs hedged legs with SYMBOL hedged-margin multiplier and FX conversion variants.
data_needed: Open hedging positions; symbol calc mode FOREX; account leverage/currencies; optional magic filter.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: USDCHF, EURUSD, AUDNZD hedge examples; live account state
why_new_for_mis: Formal aggregate-exposure taxonomy and margin sensor for hedged books—MIS can track locked vs netting regimes and capital load as portfolio-state features.
quote: If the buy and sell volumes are equal, this is the full hedge. If they are not equal, it is a sign of a partial hedge.

mechanism: For each TargetPeriod bar, CopyRates from finer SourcePeriod; distribute each M1 tick_volume uniformly across its low→high price steps (rounded to 1/10/100 points); build HDDATA pcur/vcur arrays; CHDiags draws horizontal bars (line/rectangle) scaled to max volume. Optional right-edge alignment.
data_needed: Target TF High/Low/time; Source TF MqlRates with tick_volume; hdStep rounding; hdHorSize max candles.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Demo on chart symbol; TargetPeriod=D1, SourcePeriod=M1; MaxHDcount days
why_new_for_mis: Intraday tick-volume-at-price profile per day—MIS liquidity/POC-style sensor without Level II, reusable across any symbol with tick_volume.
quote: For each obtained MqlRates structure, it is considered that tick_volume is evenly distributed within the range from low to high of the structure.

mechanism: EMA(13) slope over InpBarsEMA bars: count up vs down steps; UP/DOWN if share ≥ InpMinTrendPercentage. Buy when UP and BearsPower[1]<0 but rising vs [2]; Sell when DOWN and BullsPower[1]>0 but falling. Multi-symbol D1 scan from symbol file.
data_needed: Custom MA/Bulls/Bears handles per symbol; bars for trend; min trend %; OHLC for nearest extremum SL.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: US equities path (CAT, MCD, V, ~100 NYSE/NASDAQ); futures; D1; EMA/Bulls/Bears period 13; Option2 higher TF for EMA
why_new_for_mis: Classic Elder-Ray: trend from EMA consistency plus opposing-force oscillator recovering toward zero—MIS bull/bear strength regime on a multi-name daily universe.
quote: trend goes up (according to EMA); Bears Power is below zero but goes up… Bulls Power shows the ability of bulls to raise the price above the average agreement on the asset value.

mechanism: Master EA decodes SellStop price in ticks (1–5) as commands; edits chart templates to flip expertmode; places info orders with EA name/status in comments. Ops/control channel only.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any charts with EAs; command orders near 1–5 ticks
why_new_for_mis: No market sensing idea after full read—remote EA enable/disable and order/position mop-up tooling.
quote: This article proposed the method for the EA remote control in the MetaTrader 5 platform.

mechanism: CLimitTakeProfit::OrderSend wraps SLTP requests; places comment-tagged limit closes linked to position ticket; OnTrade syncs volumes and close-by on hedge. Execution plumbing only.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: MACD Sample EA demo; any symbol with TP
why_new_for_mis: No market sensing idea after full read—take-profit execution substitute, not a market sensor.
quote: This article offers the mechanism of replacing a position's take profit with close by limit orders.

mechanism: ZigZag→CTrends merges short corrections; CPattern requires 4 extrema with correction/trend ∈[min,max] Fibo band and retest similarity; Case-2 entry: confirm on lower TF that neckline breaks then retests and closes beyond; invalidate if extremum or measured move hit; dual TP at 90% of pattern height and prior trend.
data_needed: ZigZag depth/deviation/backstep; min/max correction; work TF + confirmation TF OHLC.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; pattern TF M30; confirmation M5; 9 months 2018 test
why_new_for_mis: Programmatic double-top/bottom reversal event with neckline-retest confirmation—MIS regime-change timestamps at support/resistance failures.
quote: The Double top/bottom pattern… is formed at the end of a trend when the price meets a support or resistance level… rolls back again instead of breaking through it.
